label: DAS Collector OPC UA
info: Collects all das/common MQTT sensor streams and exposes the latest DAS values through an OPC UA server.

name: DAS collector: subscribes to das/common/# and exposes scalar values through OPC UA at opc.tcp://localhost:53880/UA/DAS/
info: The flow keeps the latest value per line/equipment/sensor in flow context and updates OPC UA variables. Raw vibration arrays are intentionally not exposed by default; set SEND_RAW_VIBRATION_TO_OPCUA to true in the collector function if an OPC UA Double Array is required.
